title: CBA approved golden case (ADR-0016)
description: Structure schema for the CBA four-factor golden set. A separate contract from approved_case.schema.json because the CBA cases assert a different registry (2.0.0-approved-oq-cba-004), a three-state evidence discriminator the G1 cases had no vocabulary for, and a scoring mode that did not exist when the G1 set was ratified. Every case names the ADR-0016 proposals it asserts, so a case can never be added for a behaviour nobody approved.

asserts.description: What this case pins, in the words of the ADR's own golden-case table.

adr_proposals.description: The ADR-0016 proposals this case asserts. Non-empty: a golden case with no approved decision behind it is a behaviour nobody sanctioned being frozen into the suite.

owner_decisions.description: Owner decisions this case asserts, for cases outside ADR-0016's table (B26: Q1/D2, Q7 = A, unknown load). A case names adr_proposals, owner_decisions, or both.

as_of.description: The run's UTC date the load window is measured from (B26 T8c). Required by the runner for a registry with a load band table.

scoring_mode.description: The mode the case is scored under. null means the superseded pre-ADR-0016 model and is legitimate only for the supersession case.

sector.description: The speaker's one primary sector code (customer §7 cardinality), or null for none on file.

role.description: The speaker's one primary role category code, or null for none on file.

profile_present.description: Whether a speaker profile row was read at all. false is a genuine unknown; true with no text is the observed absence §9 states a policy for.

topic_score.description: The comparison the fixture provider replays for this candidate's evidence. Absent means no recording, which the factor turns into an unknown.

distance_miles.description: The already-resolved distance from the CPP campus. Never resolved by the domain (OQ-CBA-024); a case that omits it is asserting an unresolved address, not a far one.

load.description: The speaker's declared capacity and bookings (B26 T8c). Hours are decimal strings converted to exact microseconds; null hours are unknown, never 0.

applied_weights.description: The normalized weights the model must apply, keyed by factor, to six places.

scored_factor_keys.description: Exactly the factors the model may produce. Listing them is how a case asserts that proximity is absent under cba-virtual-1 rather than present-and-unknown.

ranking.description: Subject ids in the order rank_cba_candidates must return them.

excluded.description: Subjects removed at Stage A, in pool order (B26 T8c: load_full).

registry_hash.description: Pinned registry_hash literals with default weights, keyed by scoring mode (or g1).

load_multiplier.description: The registry's multiplier for the band, as a canonical decimal string.

utilization.description: Compared as a Decimal value; null without capacity.
